amendments.operator_decision: Llama byte-parity (the Stage A/B evidence) is the correctness anchor and validation harness, not the product boundary. The product is kvpack — cache reuse and multi-node communication — demonstrated by disaggregated serving. NVFP4 is the mandated producer format: it is the fast FLOPS on DGX Spark, period; alternatives are out of scope. The Mac implements whatever is necessary to decode the same artifact natively. The anchor gates are retargeted from llama-vs-muser to producer-vs-Mac bit agreement plus measured drift vs the kquant reference.
amendments.product_lane: kvpack cache reuse and multi-node communication demonstrated by disaggregated Spark NVFP4 prefill and Mac native NVFP4 decode
correctness_gates: measured drift versus the pinned kquant Tier-1 reference
